    AI Overview
    Country singer Riley Green makes his acting debut in the Yellowstone spin-off Marshals, appearing in Season 1, Episode 8, "Blowback," which premiered on CBS on April 19, 2026 . Green plays Garrett, a former Navy SEAL and old teammate of Kayce Dutton (Luke Grimes) who arrives with a troubled past to seek help .
    Watch this video to see a preview of Riley Green's debut in Marshals:
    57s
    Marshals: Watch Riley Green Make His Acting Debut Opposite ...

    YouTube• Apr 14, 2026
    Key Details About Riley Green's Role:
    • Character: Garrett, a gritty former SEAL with "demons" and a complicated history with both Kayce and Cal .
    • Debut: He appeared in Episode 8, titled "Blowback" .
    • Musical Element: The character plays guitar and performs, bringing a piece of Green's real-life career into the role .
    • Behind the Scenes: Green, a country star known for "Ain't My Last Rodeo," is close friends with Luke Grimes, which helped facilitate the role .
    • Future Episodes: Green is expected to appear in multiple episodes as his character settles in near the ranch .
    Marshals serves as a major acting debut for Green, who has described it as a challenging but rewarding shift from his music career .
